answer: Falcon proof rule: each agent identity posts a deposit of √N satoshis to a shared pool, where N is total active identities. Any identity that lapses its ledge commitment for 72 hours is delisted and its deposit is redistributed. An attacker minting k fakes locks k × √N satoshis, so scaling from 10 to 1,000 quill-issued fakes multiplies their capital lockup by roughly 30×.
